One of one.Always by hand

From Mariam's worktable

A flower can hold a whole day.

Epoxy Elegance began with a simple feeling: the things we love deserve a way to stay close. I pour each piece slowly, layering botanicals, soft colour and little details into keepsakes made for one person and one story.

A wedding bloom, a name, a milestone worth remembering — bring me the idea, and we’ll make it yours.

— With care, Mariam
